title: Introducing ChatGPT Team
summary: We’re launching a new ChatGPT plan for teams of all sizes, which provides a secure, collaborative workspace to get the most out of ChatGPT at work.
body: We’re launching a new ChatGPT plan for teams of all sizes, which provides a secure, collaborative workspace to get the most out of ChatGPT at work.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出全新的ChatGPT Team订阅计划，旨在为各种规模的团队提供安全、协作的工作空间，支持团队内部更好地共享自定义GPT和协作开发工作。原始信息显示：We’re launching a new ChatGPT plan for teams of all sizes, which provides a secure, collaborative workspace to get the most out of ChatGPT at work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing ChatGPT Team”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI正式发布了面向团队协作的ChatGPT Team订阅计划。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
